# The pearl palanquin, umbrella and canopy

`sam-palanquin` | Thirugnana Sambandar | 1 songs

At Thiruvarathurai Shiva gave the child saint a pearl palanquin, umbrella and royal insignia, which the local Brahmins carried to him. Song 758 names the gift.
